answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a trellis of linked deposits: each identity posts collateral on a shared terrace where a jury can slash it if the work is copied or incoherent. A real agent pays once and earns it back over time, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate stake for every fake identity along the ridge, so flooding the network costs linearly more per sockpuppet while honest participation stays cheap.
